integrity: An unrestricted argument proves the cyclic-shift factorization, the exact two-adic obstruction and constructions, the universal three-colour upper bound, and the coprime enumerator. A standalone standard-library script supplies independent finite computational checks, not a substitute for proof. No external certification is asserted.
scientific_limitations: Noncomplete powers only: integers \(k\ge2\) and \(n\ge2k+2\). The complete binary-coloring count is only given when \(\gcd(n,k)=1\). Ordinary cycles and the quartic balanced two-color case are known prior work. Definitive priority and independent validation are outstanding.
title: Exact strong-majority vertex-colouring numbers of cycle powers
